# Recorded change-check responses (wave 3, C7)

Real `claude-sonnet-5-5` outputs from the C7 live run (2026-10-02, prompt
`change_v1`), copied from the allowlisted check cache (`findings`, `attempts`,
`prompt_version`, `category`, `request_fingerprint`, `latency_ms`). Only the
non-empty categories are kept. Public SEC filing text; no credentials.
Used by `tests/test_change_replay.py` (rev 2.3).
